data.ctTitle: Phase 3, Randomized Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of TAR-210 Erdafitinib Intravesical Delivery System Versus Single Agent Intravesical Chemotherapy in Participants With Intermediate-risk Non-muscle Invasive Bladder Cancer (IR-NMIBC) and Susceptible FGFR Alterations
data.conditions: FGFR+ Intermediate-risk Non-muscle Invasive Bladder Cancer
data.primaryEndPoint: DFS will be measured as the time from randomization to the date of the first documented recurrence of NMIBC of any grade, disease progression, or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first
